plr.stop.PENDING_TERMS: The premises' Player service has not started
plr.stop.SUSPENDED: The premises' Player service is suspended
plr.stop.RESTRICTED: The premises' Player service is restricted
plr.stop.REVOKED: The premises' Player service has been revoked
plr.stop.ENDED_AT_REQUEST: The premises' Player service ended at its request
plr.stop.ENDED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The premises' Player service ended out of scope
plr.stop.NONE: The premises has no Player service
plr.stop.DEVICE_NONE: The device is not paired with the premises
devices.title: Player devices of your premises
devices.meta: Each device paired with a premises you act for, as it last reported.
devices.emptyTitle: No Player device is paired with this premises yet.
devices.emptyText: Go to Player, then Devices, create a pairing code and enter it on the device.
plr04.title: Player device
plr04.offDetail: Music is playing from what the device already holds.
plr04.limitTitle: Without a connection, playback stops at {ts}
plr04.limitText.policy: This is the limit in the approved policy, version {n}, with no grace period. Playback resumes once the device reaches RightOne again.
plr04.limitText.policyGrace: This is the limit in the approved policy, version {n}, including a grace period of {g} hours. Playback resumes once the device reaches RightOne again.
plr04.limitText.snapshot: No policy is approved yet, so the limit is the shortest one in the entitlement from the last synchronisation, with no grace period. Playback resumes once the device reaches RightOne again.
plr04.ceilDetail: {n} events are waiting to be sent, which is the limit. Music keeps playing.
plr04.ceilText: New plays are not recorded as evidence. The waiting events stay on the device and go out at the next connection. Check the internet connection at the premises, or call support.
plr04.evNote: At the limit the device stops recording new evidence, and the music keeps playing.
plr04.stopText.PENDING_TERMS: The device is paired, but it plays only once the service is active.
plr04.stopText.SUSPENDED: No music plays at this premises while the service is suspended.
plr04.stopText.RESTRICTED: For now a restriction works like a suspension. No music plays at this premises.
plr04.stopText.REVOKED: No music has played at this premises since the revocation. A revoked service does not become active again.
plr04.stopText.ENDED_AT_REQUEST: The service ended at the premises' request, so no music plays here any more.
plr04.stopText.ENDED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: The premises is no longer within the direct licence, so the service ended and no music plays here any more.
plr04.stopText.NONE: A device plays only for a premises whose Player service is active.
plr04.stopText.DEVICE_SUSPENDED: RightOne sends the device nothing while it is suspended. Operations can reinstate a suspended device.
plr04.stopText.DEVICE_REVOKED: This device has been revoked and can no longer act.
plr04.stopText.DEVICE_NONE: The device is not paired with any premises.
plr04.stopDo.PENDING_TERMS: Accept the terms on the premises' Player service page to start the service.
plr04.stopDo.SUSPENDED: See the reason and the conditions for reinstatement on the premises' Player service page. Once the service is reinstated, the device resumes on its own.
plr04.stopDo.RESTRICTED: See the reason and the conditions for reinstatement on the premises' Player service page. Once the service is reinstated, the device resumes on its own.
plr04.stopDo.REVOKED: See the reason for the revocation on the premises' Player service page.
plr04.stopDo.ENDED_AT_REQUEST: See the cause and when it took effect on the premises' Player service page.
plr04.stopDo.ENDED_OUT_OF_SCOPE: See the cause and when it took effect on the premises' Player service page.
plr04.stopDo.NONE: Enrol the premises in the Player service under Player.
plr04.stopDo.DEVICE_SUSPENDED: Contact support to learn why, and when the device will be reinstated.
plr04.stopDo.DEVICE_REVOKED: Pair the device again with a new authorisation. What it already recorded is kept.
plr04.stopDo.DEVICE_NONE: Create a pairing code under Devices and enter it on the device.
plr04.stopFine: Playback stopped because of the premises' service. The device is not at fault.
plr05.headline: Playback has stopped
plr05.subject: The offline limit was reached at {ts}
plr05.why.policy: The licence on the device allows {hours} hours offline under the approved policy, version {n}, with no grace period.
plr05.why.policyGrace: The licence on the device allows {hours} hours offline under the approved policy, version {n}, including a grace period of {g} hours.
plr05.why.snapshot: The licence on the device allows {hours} hours offline. No policy is approved yet, so this is the shortest limit in the last synchronised entitlement, with no grace period.
plr05.do: Restore the internet connection. The device resumes on its own once it reaches RightOne.
plr05.condText: Playback stopped under a condition of the licence the device holds.
plr06.scan: Scan with your phone for the lyrics, or to verify this venue.
plr06.scanOffline: Scan with your phone for the lyrics.
plr06.scanIdle: Scan with your phone to verify this venue.
plr06.qrLabel: QR code that opens the now-playing page on a guest's phone
plr06.lyricsWhy: Lyrics are not available for now. The music is not affected.
plr06.verifyWhy: Verification is not available for now. The music is not affected.
plr04.sync.text.COMPLETE: The device holds every track the premises may play.
plr04.sync.text.IN_PROGRESS: Music keeps playing from what the device holds. A new track plays only once it has fully arrived.
plr04.sync.text.INTERRUPTED: The connection dropped during synchronisation. When it returns, the transfer resumes where it stopped and keeps what has arrived.
plr04.sync.headline: Online, synchronising
